body:
INVENTORY 26 Nov 2026 (lead, after the owner's chat order: server side now, admin pages + button installer). Question asked: "the UI is designed, not yet built, am I wrong?" Answer: RIGHT for the pages, with two exceptions that ARE built (the join page W-05 and the first-account step of the wizard as a command). Checked against main 72048b0: docs/15 Â§2/Â§4, docs/design/00-screen-inventory.md rows W-01..W-08, server/encore_server (routes, setup.py, join_page.py, backup.py, deploy/), server/legacy/encore-admin (the old separate admin site, 4,700 lines, ported from before the one-server design; it called Docker, so it is a SOURCE of copy and tests, not something to run).

ROW BY ROW (drawn? / changed by the new rules? / server routes that exist / built?)
W-01 Installer wizard, 8 pages + the setup-code gate: DRAWN (every page and state, 15 Â§2). New rules change: page 5 (add-ons, D-19 off-by-default Soulseek + D-20 wording: P3-20), page 6 (the page runs the Tailscale steps itself: P3-22 item 4), page 8 (the pairing QR needs P2-20, not built). Server: only `python -m encore_server setup` (a command that reads the owner's choices on stdin, makes the music server's administrator and the owner's account). NO /setup route, NO setup code anywhere in the code (the code of 15 Â§1 / hidden risk H36 is paper only). NOT BUILT.
W-02 Admin Home (health in plain words): DRAWN. Changes: a Storage row (P3-13). Server: GET info is public and carries youtube/catalogue/tools state; nothing for disk, last backup, version-vs-latest, people counts, key-expiry. NOT BUILT; needs a health endpoint.
W-03 People and invitations: DRAWN (empty, loaded, invite made, remove with a reason, password link). Changes: none beyond P3-21 (forgotten owner password). Server: COMPLETE and tested (POST/GET/DELETE invites, GET people, PATCH people/{id} lock, DELETE people/{id}, POST people/{id}/reset, devices). Only the page is missing. This is the cheapest page to build first.
W-04 Library / Away from home / Backups / Updates: DRAWN. Changes: Restore becomes a button that backs up first and asks the Host to type the server's name; Update button with its way back (D-61); Away from home runs the Tailscale steps. Server: NOTHING. backup.py is a command-line copier; update/funnel/restore exist only as the host script `deploy/encore`. Needs the helper of P3-25 (the web page must never hold the computer: P3-04).
W-05 Join page: DRAWN and BUILT (join_page.py, GET /encore/join/{code}, test_join_page.py: one identical dead page, no script/font/image, no-store). The only built page of the eight.
W-06 Web player: P6, not part of this track.
W-07 Settings (name, colour, friends on other servers, quality tier, plays any song, YouTube pace, add-ons, Storage card): DRAWN. Changes: add-ons (P3-20), the Storage card (P3-13). Server: NO writable settings store for the Host. Every setting is an environment variable read once at start (config.Settings.from_env). The `setting` table exists but holds the server's INTERNAL state, including the identity private key and the song-signing secret: a generic 'settings API' over it would be a leak waiting to happen. The admin needs its own typed, allow-listed store (a manifest per setting: key, type, default, risk text, restart-needed) with environment values as defaults; the same manifest is what P3-20's add-ons model asks for.
W-08 Logs and diagnostics: DRAWN. Server: logs go to the container's output only; no endpoint, no redaction layer (the old admin had redact.py: reuse the rules and their tests).
